jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(5)(D) inventory: Stratton School District, a town school district in the Windham Central Supervisory Union (member town: Stratton). Non-operating: tuitions all grades.

board.post_note: Stratton SD: five directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b) as the SU presents the board. Two seats are held (see the source note).

sources.note: Windham Central SU "Stratton Board Members" page (official), read from the page's raw HTML on 2026-10-22 -- the member names are dropped by rendered-text extraction (the River Valleys batch-8 pattern) but are present in the HTML: Melissa Walker (Chairperson), term length 3, expiry 2027; Joe Frigo (Vice-Chairperson), term length 1, expiry 2026; Morgan Taylor (Clerk), term length 3, expiry 2029; Kellie D'Elia-Laskin (Member), term length 3, expiry 2026; Maddie Mindich (Member), no term data published. Taylor's 2029 expiry shows the page was touched after the March 2026 election, but Frigo's and D'Elia-Laskin's cards still show terms expiring at that election -- internally inconsistent about currency, so Frigo and D'Elia-Laskin are HELD (resolving document: the March 3, 2026 Stratton SD annual meeting warning/minutes or return, Town Clerk). Walker, Taylor and Mindich are minted off the current roster (Mindich with no end -- none is published for her). Board size five is as the SU page presents the board (a section 423(b) expansion implied, the vote itself not fetched).
